transfer_rule_findings: ASU: 'credit is allowed for only MAT 342 or 343' confirmed — UCLA MATH XL 33A and SNHU MAT-350 collide; keep exactly one linear-algebra course.
ASU: CSE 100/CSE 110 exclusivity not re-found in the live catalog but consistent with archived catalog wording — treat as exclusive (likely).
ASU General Studies Gold: no policy text found stating whether one course may satisfy two Gold designations — remains an assumption; plan for one course per designation and ask CISA.

ASU transfer policy (catalog.asu.edu/transfer): accepts traditional college-level coursework graded C- or better from regionally accredited institutions; refuses CEUs, continuing-education non-credit, workshops, seminars, professional-development and other not-for-credit courses. Competency-based (UMPI YourPace) credit is not addressed — YourPace posts conventional course numbers, credits and letter grades, so it should transfer as ordinary coursework (likely). UCLA Extension X 400-series is not addressed by name; it is post-baccalaureate professional credit per UCLA, so keep the plan to XL 1-199 only.
ASU 101 is required only for first-year students with 23 or fewer transferable credits (SEMTE FAQ) — the student, arriving with 100+ credits, is exempt; no substitute needed.

UMPI ECO 207 is a combined 'Macro and Micro Economics' course (and BYU ECON 110 likewise) — ASU will post either as ECN 2XX elective and may refuse it if ECN 211 and ECN 212 are already on record; hold only one economics principles source per ASU number.
HES ENVR E-101 has become a graduate-only proseminar with a writing-test prerequisite — it cannot be taken for undergraduate credit and must be replaced (ENVR E-102 etc.).
HES CSCI E-45a/E-45b 'may be taken in any order' — E-45a is not a prerequisite for E-45b.
SNHU MAT-350 prerequisite: MAT 210 or MAT 225 with C or better (ULC MAT 265 should be accepted as MAT 225 equivalent; submit ASU transcript).
UMPI project-management sequence: an 'Introduction to Project Management' course must be completed before BUS 343, BUS 359, BUS 400 and BUS 401 — schedule it in the first UMPI session.
